items.text: Example of a covering family of $A$-algebras: $(B_i)$ with a finite subfamily such that $A\to\prod B_i$ is faithfully flat (fpqc, simplified).
Axioms for covering families
Assume fibre products exist in $C$ and are compatible with covering families. Covering families $(X_i\to X)$ satisfy:
(A) Base change. $(X_i\to X)$ covering, $X'\to X$ any morphism $\Rightarrow$
(X_i\times_XX'\to X')_i\ \text{covering}
(B) Transitivity. $(X_i\to X)$ covering and, for each $i$, $(X_{ij}\to X_i)_{j\in J_i}$ covering $\Rightarrow$
(X_{ij}\to X_i\to X)_{i,\,j\in J_i}\ \text{covering}
(C) Isomorphisms. $X'\to X$ an isomorphism $\Rightarrow$ $(X'\to X)$ is covering.
(D) Saturation. $(X_i\to X)_{i\in I}$ covering; $(X'_{i'}\to X)_{i'\in I'}$ a family such that each $X_i\to X$ factors through some $X'_{i'}$ $\Rightarrow$ $(X'_{i'}\to X)$ covering.
Pretopology: families satisfying (A), (B), (C); saturating by (D) gives a topology.
Giraud: covering sieves remove the hypothesis that fibre products exist.
Local properties
$X\mapsto\mathcal F_X$ contravariant (fibred category), inverse image $\mathcal F_X\to\mathcal F_{X'}$ for $X'\to X$.
A property holds locally on $X$ if there is a covering $(X_i\to X)$ such that it holds on every $X_i$ (for the inverse image of the situation).
Sheaves on a site
\text{presheaves on } C=\widehat C=\operatorname{Hom}(C^\circ,\mathbf{Sets});\qquad \widetilde C\subset\widehat C\ \text{sheaves (depends on the topology)}
F(X)\longrightarrow\prod_iF(X_i)\rightrightarrows\prod_{i,j}F(X_i\times_XX_j)\quad\text{exact for every covering } (X_i\to X)
Separated: $F(X)\to\prod_iF(X_i)$ injective for every covering.
$C$ small site $\Rightarrow$ $\widetilde C$ is a topos. Many sites give the same topos: $C$ = generators, topology = relations.
$\widetilde C$ is the free topos on $C$ in which the covering families become epimorphic; $a\colon\widehat C\to\widetilde C$ associated sheaf.
References: SGA 4, Exp. I (categories), II (sites), III (variable sites), IV (topoi).
The associated sheaf
i\colon\widetilde C\hookrightarrow\widehat C,\qquad a\ \dashv\ i,\qquad a\ \text{left exact}
LF(X)=\varinjlim_{(X_i\to X)}\ \operatorname{Ker}\Bigl(\prod_iF(X_i)\rightrightarrows\prod_{i,j}F(X_i\times_XX_j)\Bigr)
Coverings are filtered; in terms of covering sieves $R\subset X$ (subobjects of $X$ in $\widehat C$):
LF(X)=\varinjlim_{R}\operatorname{Hom}_{\widehat C}(R,F)
Lemma.
(a) $L$ is left exact (filtered direct limits of finite inverse limits).
(b) $LF$ is separated for every presheaf $F$.
\text{(c)}\quad G\in\widetilde C:\quad \operatorname{Hom}(F,G)=\operatorname{Hom}(LF,G)
$F$ separated $\iff$ $F\to LF$ monomorphism; $F$ sheaf $\iff$ $F\to LF$ isomorphism; $F$ separated $\Rightarrow$ $LF$ sheaf.
a=L\circ L,\qquad F\to LF\to LLF
$\widetilde C$ closed under inverse limits in $\widehat C$; direct limits in $\widetilde C$: take them in $\widehat C$, then apply $a$ (exact functor).
It remains to find a small family of generators of $\widetilde C$.
